name: e4b_chk
description: E4B with a compile checker: the solver (the e4b_bf5 prompt, hand-over instead of submit) edits; the checker runs py_compile on the edited files, fixes a syntax error, submits.

phases.name: solver
phases.description: Finds and edits the source; ends with a CHANGED line; cannot submit.

phases.name: checker
phases.description: Compiles the edited Python files, fixes a syntax error, submits.
